content_blocks.text: The old lighthouse stood sentinel on the craggy cliff, its beam slicing through the dense fog like a cold blade. Inside, the keeper, an elderly man named Arthur, sat hunched over his logbook, a faint tremor in his hand. Outside, the wind howled, a mournful symphony that seemed to echo the sorrow of the night. Arthur’s eyes flicked to the clock; it was nearly midnight, and he knew the time was coming when he would have to venture out into the storm.
